lblInfo: What Apply does: the point named here goes into the steerpoint (or target row) picked below.
lblNorth: The point's latitude (degrees, minutes), as it will go into the cartridge.
lblEast: The point's longitude (degrees, minutes), as it will go into the cartridge.
lblStpt: The steerpoint (or row of the target list) the point goes into: pick its number beside it.
btnCancel: Closes the window; nothing is placed.
btnApply: Apply: puts the point there, a steerpoint as Precision. Picked from the mission, a slot that holds a point is replaced only after a question.
numStpt: The steerpoint (or row of the target list) the point goes into. Picked from the mission, it starts on the first empty one.
